notes.notes:

* Gretel has new weapons to use! 

- A sword
- A new axe
- A giant handmade hammer and even a Baseball Bat.

notes.title: New Druid Village Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37700371/047c726b4410424b54456c7ba497bc7861254a74.png[/img]

Brand new places are waiting to be discovered in The Gretel's world.

New Buildings & Game Map:

[b]Druid Village[/b]

* Druids can appear all over Gretel's world. But you have never visited their nest before.
It's up to you to figure out what they're doing in their wild village, and most importantly, why they're after Gretel. Be careful !

[b]Features[/b]:

* Story elements of Gretel and her lost brother.

* New FootStep Sound System: Updated detailed footsteps sound for all surfaces.

[b]Fixes[/b]:

* Dozens of bugs fixed. For example, ESC key errors in menu transitions, Inventory on-off errors and many more.

* Fixed some map problem.

* Optimized for RTX 3000 series cards.

notes.title: New: Druid Camp (update 1.05)
notes.notes:
Druid society is the natives of the dangerous forest. They're pretty wild. They can suddenly appear all over the forest. Maybe when you see one, you can fight it.

But to be sure, there are dozens more in their base camps. And you can never survive there.
